name: Luck Mail, Lesser
body:
Aura faint evocation; CL 3rd; Slot armor; Price 3,750 gp; Weight 25 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This style of +1 chain shirt is decorated with small agates.

The wearer gains a +1 luck bonus on all saving throws

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells divine favor; Price 2,000 gp
